lines: ● 参赛队通过报名系统（https://www.saikr.com/vse/apmcm26）提交解题论
文的电子版。参赛论文应以 PDF 文件形式提交，文件名为“#***.pdf”，其中
“#”为题号，“***”为参赛队号。控制页（control sheet）需打印并签字，
然后扫描为 PDF 文件，或用相机／手机拍照生成 JPG 图像。控制页的文件名
为“#***cns.pdf”或“#***cns.jpg”。“支撑材料”应与竞赛相关的一切其
他文件（包括程序、数据（不含竞赛提供的原始数据）及结果等）一并打包上
传，请务必审慎提交。支撑材料的文件名为“#***fj.rar”或“# ***
fj.zip”。例如，若 apmcm26300001 队选择 A 题，则论文文件名为
“Aapmcm2630001.pdf”，控制页文件名为“Aapmcm26300001cns.pdf”或
“Aapmcm26300001cns.jpg”，支撑材料文件名为“Aapmcm26300001fj.rar”或
“Aapmcm26300001fj.zip”。

reviewed_regions.source_text:

The team submits an electronic copy of its solution paper through the registration
system (https://www.saikr.com/vse/apmcm26) Team papers should be submitted
as a PDF file, the name of paper is "#***.pdf", where "#" is the problem number,
"***" is the team number. The control sheet needs to be printed and be signed,
then you should scan it as a PDF file, or take a picture with a camera / phone to
produce a JPG image. The name of the control sheet is "#***cns.pdf" or
"#***cns.jpg". The "Support Materials" will be packaged and uploaded with all
other documents which are related to the competition (including the program, data
(excluding the original data in the competition) and the results, etc.), and you
should submit it carefully. The name of the supporting materials is "#***fj.rar", or
"# *** fj.zip". For example, if the apmcm26300001 team selects Problem A, then
the
name
of
paper
is
"Aapmcm2630001.pdf"
and
the
control
sheet
is
"Aapmcm26300001cns.pdf" or "Aapmcm26300001cns.jpg", and the name of
supporting material is "Aapmcm26300001fj.rar" or "Aapmcm26300001fj.zip".
You must submit your electronic copy of solution paper, commitment and
supporting materials (if they are not expressly required in the problem, please do
not submit) to the registration system at the same time.
